'''Tosser Five''' was a [[Stassian]] athlete who played the game of [[ringers]] on the planet [[Stassia]]. She was questioned by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Zeck Tambell]] who was looking into [[Reye Sedeya]]'s lucky [[Gambling/Legends|winning streak]].
